purpose: Who the user is, their stats, and the way into their settings.
layout: Avatar, name and one-line bio or handle at the top, a row of 2–4 stats, then grouped rows (account, preferences, help) each with an icon and chevron.

primaryAction.note: "Edit profile" as a secondary or small button under the name.

avoid: Huge cover image that pushes content down
Sign out as a filled button

variants.layout: Centred header: avatar centred with name and handle below, stats row, grouped rows.
Left header: avatar left with name and handle beside it and an Edit button right, stats as three cards, then rows.
Cover: a short coloured cover band with the avatar overlapping its bottom edge, then stats and a grid of the user's items.
